messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a perf regression on Mixtral-8b after the kernel-selection change yesterday. p99 for short chats jumped ~40ms. Tracing looks like KV-cache eviction thrash + more frequent tiny batches.

sam: can you paste the perf job / how to repro?

alex: minimal repro run on my laptop: `./bench --model mixtral-8b --ctx 8192 --batch 4 --seq 256`
Attached flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/prof/219654/fg.svg

alex: relevant log snippet:
```
[2026-03-10 14:02:11] evict_kv_range: kept=512 evicted=256 total_kv=1024 batch_id=237
[2026-03-10 14:02:11] batcher: flushed 2 requests, batch_sz=1 latency=18ms
```

priya: interesting — did the kernel-chooser fallback to the older muladd kernel on that run? which commit?

alex: it picked commit f3a9b2 (try-use-new-muladd-kernel). The chooser has a seq>512 cutoff, but Mixtral's head/kv dim interplay looks different here. Also saw a conversion warning earlier: `warning: missing field 'rotary_scaling' in HF config; defaulting to 1.0` in the safetensors conversion log.

sam: missing rotary_scaling could change effective RoPE freqs -> changes KV hit patterns for long contexts. That plus aggressive kernel fallback could cause more cache churn.

luca: fwiw the batcher heuristic currently picks max_batch based on avg tokens/req over last N=50 requests. With large ctx and lots of cached prefixes avg tokens/session drops -> it reduces target batch size and flushes faster. That increases eviction pressure. We should consider a prefix-aware gating.

alex: I experimented with pinning KV pages for warm requests: set `runtime.kv.pinned_ttl=60s`. That reduced eviction counts in the trace and brought p99 back to baseline in my local run. Not a long-term fix but promising.

priya: we should also add an hfparse lint rule: error (not warn) when `rotary_scaling` is omitted in model cfg. Conversion script should fail fast. I'll draft a PR to hfparse.

sam: I'll add a unit test for the kernel-chooser to reproduce the seq boundary fallback and ensure we don't pick fallback kernel unless it actually improves throughput for the observed head/kv dims.

luca: also adding a small change to batcher: extend the history window for models with large ctx to N=200 and incorporate `prefix_fraction` into batch sizing (heuristic: effective_batch = floor(max_batch * (1 - prefix_fraction))). Quick patch should be low-risk.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime-kv-pin-canary (canary-20260311) -> starting canary rollout to 10% hosts

alex: follow-ups checklist: 1) hfparse lint for rotary_scaling (priya) 2) kernel-chooser test + fix (sam) 3) batcher prefix-aware gating (luca) 4) unit/integration test for pinned_kv_ttl (alex) 5) perf runs and cost delta measurement (alex/luca). Perf artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/prof/219654/run-report.html

priya: I'll open the hfparse PR and add conversion tests for safetensors metadata. I'll also add a short note to onboarding checklist that conversion must include rotary_scaling and head/kv dims as explicit fields.

sam: assigned myself for kernel tests, will push branch today.

luca: will prototype batcher tweak in a branch and run perf on dedicated cluster.

alex: thanks all. small ask: when you push PRs, drop the perf link in the description so QE can pull artifacts.

luca: noted.

alex: :thumbsup:
